text:
Maya Patel: quick sync request — style alignment council? we've got 3 PRs that touch snippets + a glossary gap. @Sam @Priya :wave:
Sam Ortiz: SG. 15m huddle ok? what do we want to decide today?
Priya Nair: Main items: SDK snippet casing, REST/CLI param naming, glossary entries for "model family" vs "model variant", and a couple of microcopy fixes for error messages. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2381 (contains mixed changes atm).
Jon Park: Noticed a bunch of examples mixing `model_id` and `modelId`. Proposal: standardize JS/TS SDK snippets to camelCase, keep snake_case for raw curl/REST query params. Also want a canonical snippet repo reference. Example mismatch:
```js
// bad
const res = client.predict({ model_id: 'gpt-4' });

// good
const res = client.predict({ modelId: 'gpt-4' });
```
Leah Gomez: Tone point: our voice fluctuates. Suggest rule: "conversational & concise for guides; formal & precise for API reference." add one-liner: prefer contractions in tutorials, avoid in reference. I'll draft examples.
docs-bot: label applied: docs-style-alignment; checklist created; assignee: none.
Maya Patel: decision proposal — 1) JS/TS SDK snippets -> camelCase. 2) REST query params -> snake_case. 3) Add glossary entries for 'model family' (user-facing) and 'model variant' (internal). 4) Adopt Leah's microcopy rule. thumbs?
Sam Ortiz: :thumbsup: Agree. Also: for open PRs that touch snippets, do small follow-ups instead of big sweeping edits to reduce churn.
Priya Nair: I'll split PR 2381 into two: glossary + microcopy (PR A) and snippet/casing updates (PR B). Will tag reviewers and add a migration note in the umbrella issue. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Jon Park: I'll add a lightweight CI lint to flag non-canonical casing in JS snippets (regex based). Opening an issue to track and a tiny PR for the CI check.
Leah Gomez: I'll draft 2 positive/2 negative tone examples and put them in #docs for review.
Maya Patel: Action items recap: Priya — split PRs and open follow-ups; Jon — CI snippet check; Leah — tone examples; Sam — coordinate reviews. I'll create an umbrella issue and assign leads. Thanks team :sparkles:
Sam Ortiz: thanks! reconvene Friday if blockers.
